summary: Kanzhun Ltd (KANZHUN LIMITED) filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Next Day Disclosure Return for the Hong Kong Exchange, detailing ongoing share repurchases. The filing lists multiple repurchases of Class A ordinary shares from March to April 2026 at prices between approximately USD 6.57 and USD 7.14 per share, all repurchased for cancellation but not yet cancelled as of the closing balance date. No board recommendation or advisor is named. These are open-market buybacks managed under Hong Kong listing rules, reducing share count over time. Watch for continued buyback activity, potential cancellation, and EPS accretion.
